records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Maya,

Welcome to Wrenfield. If you're bringing a team along, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and seats can be added any time from Account Settings.

I'm around if you need anything.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

draft.subject: A hand with your first Wrenfield project?
draft.body:
Hi Maya,

Just checking in since your Wrenfield signup. Nothing's landed in the account yet, so I wanted to make it easy to get the first piece in place.

In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, and the in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project. When you're ready for the team, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through setting up that first project with you and answer anything else.

Best,
Priya
